Rina (devex): Heads-up: onboarding sample app (node) that demos paginated embeddings is causing users to hit 429s in bursts during the initial sync. Reproable with the sample and `Promise.all(pages.map(...))`.

Theo (sdk-js): that pattern will fire off concurrent page pulls. The JS SDK has a global token-bucket but the paginator spawns fetches without awaiting the bucket acquire for each page.

Rina (devex): hmm the sample uses the helper `client.paginate().collect()` to keep code short. We assumed collect would apply client concurrency limits.

Alex (sdk-go): go sdk enforces a per-client semaphore on every HTTP call, including paginator page fetches, so users of the go sample don't see the same bursts. We should probably mirror that behavior in JS.

Priya (platform): server logs: we surface `Retry-After` and `X-RateLimit-Policy: per-route` for these endpoints. Also we emit `suggested_backoff_ms` when we detect cascading retries. If client honors Retry-After that should stop the flood.

Theo (sdk-js): agreed. quick mitigation: update the sample to use an async iterator with a concurrency cap, e.g.:

```js
const q = new PQueue({concurrency: 4});
for await (const page of client.paginate('/v1/embeddings', params)) {
  q.add(() => process(page));
}
await q.onIdle();
```

Rina (devex): can we add a helper `paginate({concurrency})` option so sample code stays simple?

Theo (sdk-js): yeah we can add that. Also will patch paginate internals to consult the token-bucket on every page fetch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/987 (WIP).

Alex (sdk-go): let's ensure semantics are explicit in docs: whether concurrency is per-client or per-route. Right now go is per-client; JS default will follow that if we change it. Need parity note.

Priya (platform): also reminder: auth token refresh can interact badly with retries. If a page fetch fails with 401 and the SDK refreshes the token while other parallel fetches continue, you can get a mix of 401->retry floods. SDKs should pause parallel fetches until refresh completes (or serialize refresh).

Theo (sdk-js): good call. our auth middleware emits a `refreshing` flag but paginator didn't check it. I'll wire a fast-path to block new page fetches while refresh in progress.

Rina (devex): for the onboarding flow I want a small note about backpressure + token refresh and a runnable example that uses `concurrency: 2`. Also want an e2e test in sample-app CI that simulates 429+Retry-After.

Priya (platform): we can add a test route that returns `Retry-After: 2` and counts requests to ensure clients back off; will coordinate.

Theo (sdk-js): will add unit + integration tests. Also add a telemetry event when paginator hits server-suggested backoff so we can alert if users hit this in prod.

Alex (sdk-go): I'll update the go docs to call out the jitter/backoff params so parity is clear.

ci-bot: CI: sample-app/integration flaky test fixed on feature/paginator-concurrency — re-run https://ci.redwood.ai/54321

Rina (devex): thanks all. I'll update the quickstart to avoid `Promise.all` examples and include the small code snippet and note about auth refresh.

Theo (sdk-js): once PR is ready ping me and I'll shepherd release. Targeting patch release tomorrow.

Rina (devex): awesome, leaving a comment on the PR with the sample app change and a tiny repro harness. :sparkles:
